# Is the 200 Hz Learning Strategy Sufficient to Replace High-Frequency Low-Level Control Loops?

> **Current answer:** The 200 Hz frequency is higher than what is considered for fast low-level control above 1 kHz; whether an additional whole-body constrained controller is needed depends on system delay, actuator bandwidth, and safety constraints. No testing results are available, and the conclusion has not been resolved.
